result.instructions: Tools for Mailchimp, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mailchimp data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mailchimp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailchimp_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailchimp_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mailchimp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailchimp_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the API Root — the authenticated Mailchimp account: account name, total subscribers, contact info, plan and industry stats. REST: GET /.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_audiences
tools.title: List audiences (lists)
tools.description: List the account's audiences — Mailchimp's `/lists` resource (an audience is a list of subscribers). Paginated, with optional sort. REST: GET /lists.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

sortField.description: Field to sort by (Mailchimp `sort_field`, e.g. date_created / create_time).

tools.name: mailchimp_get_audience
tools.title: Get audience (list)
tools.description: Get a single audience (list) by id, including subscriber stats, default from-name/email and settings. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members of an audience (list). Paginated, with an optional status filter and sort. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}/members.

list_id.description: The audience (list) id to list members from.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

sortField.description: Field to sort by (Mailchimp `sort_field`, e.g. date_created / create_time).

tools.name: mailchimp_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: Get a single audience member (subscriber) by email or subscriber_hash, including status, merge fields, tags and stats. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash} (email → MD5 hash).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.

tools.name: mailchimp_search_members
tools.title: Search members
tools.description: Search for members across the account (or one audience) by email, name or other fields. Returns exact + full-text matches. REST: GET /search-members.

list_id.description: Restrict the search to this audience (list) id.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns (email sends). Paginated, with optional type/status/audience filters and sort. REST: GET /campaigns.

list_id.description: Restrict to campaigns sent to this audience (list) id.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

sortField.description: Field to sort by (Mailchimp `sort_field`, e.g. date_created / create_time).

tools.name: mailchimp_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by id, including its settings, recipients and send status. REST: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List campaign reports (aggregate performance for sent campaigns). Paginated, with an optional type filter. REST: GET /reports.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

tools.name: mailchimp_get_campaign_report
tools.title: Get campaign report
tools.description: Get the report for one campaign — opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes and other engagement summary stats. REST: GET /reports/{campaign_id}.

campaign_id.description: The campaign id to fetch the report for.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_automations
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: List the account's classic automations (automated email workflows). Paginated. REST: GET /automations.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

tools.name: mailchimp_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the account's email templates (saved and pre-built layouts). Paginated, with optional type filter and sort. REST: GET /templates.

type.description: Filter by template type (Mailchimp `type`: user / base / gallery).

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

sortField.description: Field to sort by (Mailchimp `sort_field`, e.g. date_created / create_time).

tools.name: mailchimp_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List an audience's segments and tags (saved segments include static tags). Paginated. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}/segments.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

tools.name: mailchimp_list_member_tags
tools.title: List member tags
tools.description: List the tags applied to a single audience member (by email or subscriber_hash). Paginated. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash}/tags (email → MD5 hash).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (Mailchimp `offset`, for pagination).

tools.name: mailchimp_add_member
tools.title: Add member
tools.description: Add a new member (subscriber) to an audience (list). Note: status "pending" triggers a double-opt-in confirmation email. REST: POST /lists/{list_id}/members.

list_id.description: The audience (list) id to add the member to.

status.description: Subscription status (default "subscribed"; "pending" sends a double-opt-in email).

tags.description: Array of tag-name strings to apply to the new member.

tools.name: mailchimp_update_member
tools.title: Update member
tools.description: Update an existing audience member (by email or subscriber_hash). Only the fields you supply change. REST: PATCH /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash} (email → MD5 hash).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.

merge_fields.description: Merge-field values to set, e.g. { FNAME: "Ada" }.

tools.name: mailchimp_add_member_tags
tools.title: Add/remove member tags
tools.description: Add and/or remove tags on an audience member (by email or subscriber_hash). `tags` are added (status active); `removeTags` are removed (status inactive). Mailchimp returns HTTP 204 (no body). REST: POST /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash}/tags (email → MD5 hash).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.

tags.description: Tag names to ADD to the member (mapped to status "active").

removeTags.description: Tag names to REMOVE from the member (mapped to status "inactive").

tools.name: mailchimp_archive_member
tools.title: Archive member
tools.description: Archive (soft-remove) an audience member — reversible; this is NOT the permanent-delete action. REST: DELETE /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash} (email → MD5 hash). Returns HTTP 204 (no body).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.
